Tokyo's November 2026 forecast shows daily high temperatures ranging from 54° to 69°, with overnight lows between 41° and 54°. The average high for November is 60° with an average low of 47°. results.title: Japan in November 2026: A Self-Guided Traveler's Month- ...
results.snippet:
November sits in the year's sweet spot: **dry, clear and cool**, with the country's famous fall foliage rolling south from Hokkaido to Kyushu.

### 🍁 Quick Answer: Japan in November 2026
- **Weather:** crisp and dry — Tokyo/Kyoto ~17°C day, ~7–10°C night; Hokkaido near freezing; Okinawa still ~24°C.

## November Weather in Japan 2026
| Region | Day / Night | Notes |
|-|-|-|
| Tokyo / central | 17°C / 10°C | Crisp, low humidity, ~147 hrs sun, ~96 mm rain — mostly dry |

## FAQ: Japan in November 2026
November offers mild weather, clear skies, vibrant autumn foliage, low humidity, and far fewer tourists than cherry-blossom season.

Heavy rain is uncommon.

Early November is warmer and drier, with foliage peaking in mountain and northern regions. Late November brings cooler air, shorter days and the start of peak color in Tokyo (JMC 2026: November 28), with Osaka (December 4) and Kyoto (December 11) following — late November to mid-December is the iconic foliage window for first-time visitors.
